name: Intro & Commercial Skipper
overview: Detects recurring episode intros/outros and commercial breaks, exposing them as native skippable media segments.
description: Fingerprints episode audio (via Chromaprint) to find recurring intros/outros across a season, and imports Comskip .edl files, or runs a built-in black-frame/silence heuristic, to find commercial breaks in recorded broadcast content.

versions.changelog: Removes the fpcalc dependency entirely: intro/outro fingerprinting now uses ffmpeg's own Chromaprint muxer, since jellyfin-ffmpeg bundles libchromaprint but not the fpcalc CLI tool. Also fixes the config page showing blank fields, and stops caching a false negative when ffmpeg fails to launch so fixing the path and rescanning now actually retries.

Fixes a startup crash: PluginServiceRegistrator read Plugin.Instance before it was guaranteed to be set, throwing a NullReferenceException that aborted Jellyfin's entire startup. Now resolves the plugin data directory from IApplicationPaths via DI instead.
Initial release: cross-episode intro/outro fingerprinting, Comskip .edl import, and a heuristic black-frame/silence commercial detector.
